9th Grade.title: Grade 9 ELA (EngageNY / CCSS Aligned)
9th Grade.overview: Grade 9 ELA emphasizes close reading, evidence-based literary analysis, informational synthesis, and formal argumentative composition.

modules.title: Reading Closely and Writing to Learn: How Do Authors Develop Character, Theme, and Perspective?
modules.description: Close reading and evidence-based analysis across diverse literary genres. Students examine the development of character, tone, and culture shock in Karen Russell's short story, investigate aesthetic advice and solitary reflection in Rainer Maria Rilke's epistolary prose, and unpack dramatic tragedy, structure, and poetic conventions in William Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet.

modules.title: Understanding Perspectives and Writing to Convince
modules.description: Exploration of literary perspective, structural point of view, psychological obsession, classical hubris, and investigative argument. Students analyze Edgar Allan Poe's unreliable narrator in The Tell-Tale Heart, examine Emily Dickinson's introspective sensory metaphors in I felt a Funeral, in my Brain, dissect fate, dramatic irony, and moral catastrophe in Sophocles' Oedipus the King, and evaluate cultural fascination with crime and justice in Walter Mosley's True Crime.
